fields.name: shortName
fields.label: Short name (used in the venue switcher)

fields.name: phoneNote
fields.label: Phone: pending confirmation
fields.description: Fill this in only while the number is in doubt. It renders a "Pending confirmation" tag beside the number everywhere it appears. Clear it as soon as the venue confirms.

fields.name: latitude
fields.label: Latitude
fields.description: Leave empty unless the coordinate comes from the venue itself. A geocode we guessed is worse than none: it ships as GeoCoordinates in LocalBusiness schema and can send people to the wrong building. Google geocodes fine from the address alone.

fields.name: longitude
fields.label: Longitude
fields.description: See Latitude. Both must be present before either is published.

fields.name: verified
fields.label: Details confirmed by the venue
fields.description: Leave off until someone at the venue has checked every field on this page.

fields.name: state
fields.label: Registration state
fields.description: Every state shows an action. The page never dead-ends.

fields.name: oneLiner
fields.label: One line — format and commitment
fields.description: e.g. "Eight weeks. Two-person teams. Wednesday nights."

fields.name: beginnerNote
fields.label: Beginner reassurance
fields.description: Required. Two-thirds of league pages skip this and it is the top reason people do not join.

options.label: Monthly membership — drawn as a card
LinksFlex hour bank — drawn as a fuel gauge

fields.name: recommendedNote
fields.label: Why we recommend it
fields.description: Give a REASON the customer can check ("$149 ÷ $35 pays back after about 4.3 hours a month"), never "Most popular" — that is a claim about other people that a buyer cannot verify.

fields.name: price
fields.label: Monthly price (number only, no $)
fields.description: A NUMBER, e.g. 149. The page adds the $ and does the per-hour arithmetic itself.

fields.name: window
fields.label: LinksFlex: when the hours can be used

fields.name: ageRestricted
fields.label: LinksFlex: age-restricted tier
fields.description: Tick for Junior. Keeps this tier out of the "LinksFlex from $X an hour" headline, so we never quote a price most readers cannot buy.

fields.name: price
fields.label: Price (number only, no $)
fields.description: The per-hour figure is divided from this. Do not enter it separately.

fields.name: current
fields.label: This is the current rate card

fields.name: name
fields.label: Who said it
fields.description: Only publish a name you have permission to use.

description.value: References another document, used as a foreign key
